视觉与核查
冷灰石拓/版刻视觉，泉纹与荷影构成左下和底部的横向节奏，有别于原A的青绿山水彩墨。石拓只是一种当代艺术表现方法，不代表某件济南历史石刻或专属地方非遗。中心/右上相对平静，但石粒纹理较密，密集小字可能需要浅灰承托层；避免把正文跨在左下黑色荷影上。
地域视觉线索是任务指定的泉水与荷意；未使用参考图片，未仿造或拼接外站素材。
现存A资格备注：济南旧A有彩墨晕染和山水虚实，可作为广义彩墨A候选，但仍含明显版刻线痕；尚需统筹确认风格分类。

完整生成提示词（本图实际调用原文）
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE original standalone cultural city-detail background illustration, B = craft-led fusion version, not a webpage mockup. One full-bleed 16:9 landscape image at maximum available native clarity. Never a contact sheet, comparison board, split screen or multi-panel picture.
Primary objective: visibly Chinese handmade artistic expression grounded in the user's local cultural motifs. Make craft-specific marks, the way colors are printed and the spatial rhythm do the work; do not produce a generic digital wallpaper, smooth gradient, shiny CGI, stock vector pattern, or the same pale blue-green mountains recolored. This must differ in composition, palette and medium from the city's existing airy ink-wash candidate.
Reading use: naturally integrate a spacious low-frequency reading area rather than a visible rectangular blank panel. Preserve a calm part of the central mobile-crop strip (x=35%-65%, y=15%-65%); no dense high-contrast motifs in its upper reading area. Let characteristic handmade detail survive near its lower edge so a center-cropped phone view still has identity. Foreground text and controls will be supplied separately.
Hard exclusions: no text, Chinese characters, letters, numbers, calligraphy, inscriptions, carved writing, signatures, seals, logos, watermarks, QR codes, UI, frames, maps, administrative boundaries or cartographic silhouettes. No people, literal monuments, historical scenes, actual historical artifact reconstruction, archaeological objects, photographed craft products or specific real artwork. Do not copy any website or existing image. This is visibly AI-creative illustration, not a real artifact, geography or historical record.
City: Jinan.
Primary request: an original poetic fusion of hand-worked stone-rubbing / engraved print language and restrained ink wash, inspired by spring-water ripples and lotus leaves. Treat stone carving as an artistic rendering method, NOT as a claim that this represents a specific Jinan historic carving.
Palette and ground: cool light silver-grey, soft flint, charcoal ink, and a very small amount of pale jade-green mineral wash. NO warm parchment, antique beige paper, cobalt/amber glass, red festival color or blue-green mountain landscape. A fine, subtly mottled printed stone-grain texture rather than a photograph of an actual rock, slab, stele or wall.
Composition: an asymmetric low horizontal concentration of engraved spring-water curves flows across the LOWER quarter from left to right. Several large, elegantly cropped lotus-leaf impressions enter from the lower-left edge, defined by beautiful white incised veins in charcoal/smoke-grey printed masses. Some carving marks break naturally into diluted ink wash at their edges. Leave the upper-middle and center-right as an expansive softly lit silver-grey ground, with barely perceptible ink diffusion, calm enough for dark charcoal typography. No centered blank white sheet and no symmetrical ornamental border. A faint ripple echo can survive at the bottom of the central crop.
Craft specificity: convincingly irregular hand-cut grooves, ink-rubbing broken edges, fine dry pressure marks, the alternation of pale engraved channels and dense flat ink, crisp but imperfect lotus ribs. The overall impression is a thoughtful contemporary Chinese rubbing-print composition with tactile restraint. Not a glossy carved 3D relief, not weathered historical stone, not generic marble, not a literal old rubbing displayed as a museum object.
Mood: cool, fresh, quiet spring clarity, sophisticated broad rhythms. Do not paint hills, temples, lakeside buildings, naturalistic flowers or crashing sea waves.
